Problem: Write a python function to check whether the given number can be represented by product of two squares or not.

Tests:
assert prod_Square(25) == False
assert prod_Square(30) == False
assert prod_Square(16) == True

Write the t task named `prod_Square` with 1 parameter(s) of type(s) int, in the order the tests pass them, returning bool. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
